sources.title: The Prohibition of AI Emotion Recognition Technologies in the Workplace under the AI Act
sources.publisher: Wolters Kluwer — Global Workplace Law & Policy
data_points: EU AI Act Article 5(1)(f) prohibits AI systems inferring emotions in workplace and education from February 2, 2025
Fines reach EUR 35 million or 7% of global annual turnover
Applies to all EU-based employers regardless of headquarters
Text-based sentiment analysis is explicitly exempt

sources.title: Hume AI Announces $50 Million Fundraise and Empathic Voice Interface
data_points: Hume AI closed $50M Series B in March 2024
Round led by EQT Ventures with Union Square Ventures, Nat Friedman & Daniel Gross, Comcast Ventures, LG Technology Ventures
Funding supports Empathic Voice Interface (EVI) development
EVI analyzes human emotional tone in real-time voice

sources.title: Smart Eye Completes Acquisition of Affectiva
data_points: Smart Eye acquired Affectiva for approximately USD 73.5 million
Acquisition completed June 2021
Affectiva founded 2009 as MIT Media Lab spin-off by Dr. Rana el Kaliouby and Dr. Rosalind Picard
Combined company focused on emotion AI + eye-tracking for automotive and media analytics

sources.title: Red Lines under EU AI Act: Prohibition of Emotion Recognition in Workplace and Education
data_points: Article 5(1)(f) bans AI systems that infer emotions based on biometric data in workplaces and education
Narrow medical/safety exception available if it passes a proportionality test
Text-based sentiment analysis from written text is explicitly NOT covered by the prohibition
Ban has been enforceable since February 2, 2025

sources.title: Europe Banned Workplace Emotion AI. The US Is Letting It Scale.
data_points: EU AI Act creates regulatory divergence between EU (banned in workplaces) and US (no federal restriction)
US companies scaling emotion AI in employment contexts facing no federal barriers
China actively promotes emotion AI in public safety and education

unverified_claims.note: Calculated from CAGR backcast using 22-27% CAGR data. Exact 2021 market size not directly sourced — treat as estimated range (+150% to +250%).
Extrapolated from Q2 2026 acceleration signals (SNS Insider July 2026 report + Google DeepMind deal). Not directly sourced from a quarterly growth report.
Realeyes is widely cited as leader in advertising emotion testing vertical but exact market share percentage is not available from public sources.
